title: Quest Foglight for Databases installLicense Directory Traversal Remote Code Execution Vulnerability. (CVE-2026-92192)
description: CVE-2026-92192 is a directory traversal vulnerability in the installLicense script of Quest Foglight for Databases. It allows authenticated remote attackers to execute arbitrary code with SYSTEM privileges by exploiting improper validation of user-supplied paths in file operations. The vulnerability has a high severity with a CVSS score of 8.8.
